# Web model assets

This folder contains the web-ready 3D assets loaded by the browser viewer.

## `robot-arm_digital-twin.glb`

This GLB file is the exported model used by the web application.

It is expected to originate from the Blender scene documented in:

- `blender/scene/robot-arm_digital-twin-WEB.blend`

When preparing new web exports, use that scene as the source so that pivot structure and naming remain compatible with `web/src/main.js`.
